2610.03526.title: Beyond Trained Models: Compiling GNNs for a Sound Explainer Benchmark
2610.03526.paper_summary: Explainers for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are commonly evaluated by their plausibility, i.e., how well their explanations recover a predefined ground truth, such as a motif planted in the data. This protocol implicitly assumes that a GNN trained on such data relies on the intended motif. Although prior work has questioned this assumption, plausibility remains widespread. First, we show that the assumption is violated on several widely used benchmarks, where, e.g., degree statistics alone suffice to solve the task. Then, we remove this confounder by replacing training with compilation. We achieve this by introducing $\mathsf{Gracr}$, the first compiler translating graded modal logic formulas into GNN weights, yielding models that replicate the behaviour of the corresponding formulas. Since the behaviour of the model is now known by construction, we can define its ground truth explanation formally and compute it exactly. Building on this, we introduce $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$, a benchmark of compiled GNNs for the evaluation of explainers against this exact ground truth. Experiments on eleven explainers across six tasks show its effectiveness for fine-grained diagnostic evaluation: notably, we discover that most explainers are not robust to indirect influences or alternative implementations of the same formula. These results position $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$ as a novel, rigorous evaluation setting for graph post-hoc explainability.
2610.03526.paper_summary_zh: 解釋圖神經網絡（GNNs）通常通過其可信度進行評估，即它們的解釋在多大程度上恢復了預定的真實情況，例如數據中植入的主題。這一協議隱含地假設，基於這類數據訓練的GNN依賴於預期的主題。儘管之前的研究對這一假設提出了質疑，但可信度仍然廣泛存在。首先，我們展示了這一假設在幾個廣泛使用的基準上被違反，例如，僅僅依賴度數統計就足以解決該任務。然後，我們通過用編譯替代訓練來消除這一混淆因素。我們通過引入$\mathsf{Gracr}$來實現這一點，這是第一個將分級模態邏輯公式轉換為GNN權重的編譯器，從而產生能夠複製相應公式行為的模型。由於模型的行為現在是通過構造來確定的，我們可以正式定義其真實解釋並準確計算。基於此，我們引入了$\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$，這是一個編譯GNN的基準，用於根據這一精確真實情況對解釋器進行評估。在六個任務上對十一個解釋器的實驗顯示了其在細粒度診斷評估中的有效性：值得注意的是，我們發現大多數解釋器對間接影響或同一公式的替代實現並不穩健。這些結果使得$\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$成為一個新穎而嚴謹的圖後驗可解釋性評估環境。
